texts.preamble: Mohinder Pal vs State Of Haryana on 22 July, 2015 Author: Mahesh Grover Bench: Mahesh Grover Crl. Revision No.182 of 2007(O&M) 1 In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana At Chandigarh Crl. Revision No.182 of 2007 Date of Decision : 22.07.2015 Mohinder Pal ....Petitioner Versus State of Haryana ...Respondent Coram : Hon'Ble Mr.Justice Mahesh Grover
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that he does not wish to address on the merits of the case but confines his prayer to the limited extent that some leniency be shown on quantum of sentence. Considering the fact that the sample was taken by the respondents in 1997 and the petitioner has faced the ordeal of criminal prosecution for the last 18 years and also the fact that out of six months awarded to him, the petitioner has already undergone two months and there has been no further violation of any provisions of the Food Adulteration Act. This view is supported by the judgment of this Court passed in Ramesh Kumar v. State of Haryana 2010(3) Crimes 549.
